articles.title: The Climate Question Hanging Over Anthropic’s IPO
articles.summary: From a business, economics, or technology angle, the record-breaking Anthropic IPO is one of the biggest stories of the year. Raising around $81 billion, it was the biggest IPO of all time. And it’s perhaps the cleanest signal of how interwoven the economy has become with AI. But the Anthropic IPO also provides an important lens into this moment for energy and climate . articles.title: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping Blurs Into a Cloud of Drudgery
articles.summary: Just when you think there’s no more life in a franchise, an executive somewhere puts a crowbar in the crypt and revives an old moneymaker for one more round. The first four Hunger Games movies, released from 2012 to 2015 and adapted from Suzanne Collins’ enormously successful young-adult novels , featured Jennifer Lawrence as the ever-plucky Katniss Everdeen. She gave those movies a bristling vitality that could keep you watching even if you had no interest in the material's hyper-dramatic teen dystopian visions .

articles.title: Here Are the Senators Who Are Backing Van Hollen Over Schumer for Senate Majority Leader
articles.summary: Senator Chris Van Hollen has said that he has the backing of about 15 of his colleagues in his quest to challenge Senator Chuck Schumer for Senate Majority Leader.
